tema: a gentle bedtime and not fearing the dark
baslik: Momo the Bear and the Starry Night | Bedtime Story
ders: The night is calm and the stars shine for us
aciklama: When Momo's lamp goes off, Pip shows him the twinkling stars and the smiling moon. A calm bedtime story that helps little ones feel cozy at night.

satirlar.metin: Pip, my lamp went off! Why is my room so dark?
Don't worry, Momo. Let's go to the window and look outside.
Outside, the night sky was full of little twinkling stars.
Ooh, they look like tiny night-lights, just for us!
And look, the moon is smiling down at you, Momo!
Then Luna the owl landed softly on a branch nearby.
Hoo! The night is calm and quiet, so everyone can rest.
So the dark is just a cozy, sleepy blanket for the world!
Momo snuggled into bed and waved goodnight to the stars.
Goodnight, stars. Goodnight, moon. Goodnight, friends!
When it is dark, remember the stars are shining just for you.
